abstract: Deploy vLLM on Kubernetes through KServe in Standard mode and autoscale it with KEDA from vLLM Prometheus metrics. Covers InferenceService with a pinned vLLM ClusterServingRuntime, the generated ScaledObject, LLMInferenceService with direct KEDA scaling and the deprecated WVA path, install paths and version pins, calibration, scale-to-zero caveats, troubleshooting and teardown. References are split into install, InferenceService, LLMInferenceService, and tuning plus troubleshooting.
